description.en: Shorthand for StartScEvent with its _shadow argument forced to true — starts a match-side cutscene whose temporary goal model casts a shadow.
Whether the cutscene runs on the "upper" display side.
Output array; filled with [normalMapHandle, wazaMapHandle, goalModelHandle] when _is_upper is set.
No explicit return statement (an early `return;` with no value when no match is active) — implicitly null.
